summary: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories furnished a Form 6-K on October 7, 2026, disclosing that it will release Q2 FY27 results on October 23, 2026 and host an earnings call at 19:30 IST / 10:00 ET. The filing is a routine earnings-call intimation to the NSE, BSE, NYSE and NSE IFSC, not a transaction. No stake, price, premium, advisor or board recommendation is stated. No structural or regulatory mechanics apply. The event to watch is the October 23 results and management commentary; no risk-arb angle is present.
